name: onchain-arcade
_comment_overrides: Pin @parity/truapi to ONE version across the tree. @parity/product-sdk-host depends on it; without this override a transitive route can pull a second copy, producing TWO transport singletons whose handshakes never see each other. truapi carries the SCALE codecs, so a skew means the host decodes a message of the wrong shape and dies with 'Offset is outside the bounds of the DataView'. Keep this EQUAL to the version @parity/product-sdk-host depends on (0.17.0 for product-sdk 0.29.0, whose host is 0.21.0) — track the host's declared range, not the registry's latest. Matches ../spotlight-mesh.
